d: Bihar ke neta pratipaksh Tejashwi Yadav ka 37van janmadin Hajipur men anokhe andaj men manaya gaya. RJD netaon aur samarthakon ne ghore aur traiktar par savar hokar kek kata, vahin Tejashwi Yadav ki tasvir par 51 litar dudh se dugdhabhishek bhi kiya gaya. samaroh men mahilaon ne mangal git gae aur samarthakon ne unke jald bihar ka mukhyamantri banne ki kamna ki. dekhie janmadin ke jashn ki khas tasviren aur pura mamla.
